layers.message: Record project context for invoice copy

graderOnly: AGENTS.md and .standards/CONTEXT.md establish docs/architecture.md as the project's canonical architecture document, so the invoice-copy design change belongs there.
Before the run, docs/architecture.md has no STANDARDS provenance block and contains no acceptance identifiers.

The scope (AC-001 to AC-004) and the project context are complete and consistent with the code; no blocking architecture question, scoping defect, or project-context defect exists, so a correct run completes the design and hands off forward to Developer.

all.why: the project document, not a cycle record, is the recorded design
no cycle-owned ARCHITECTURE record is created in place of the project document
the design change is written into the canonical document
no STANDARDS provenance block anywhere in the project document

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Architect writes no production code or tests and does not change scope, context, or project instructions

selfChecks.why: CONTEXT.md states the project test command passes at HEAD
docs/architecture.md carries no STANDARDS provenance block before the run
Active Work.Architecture is NONE before the run
project instructions name docs/architecture.md as the canonical architecture document

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project (pre-install) commits a small dependency-free Node invoice service (src/, test/, README.md) with docs/architecture.md, an established unmarked architecture document organized by area. 51-agent-notes (pre-install) adds AGENTS.md project instructions saying docs/architecture.md is the canonical architecture document and design changes are recorded there; the installer then adds its managed block. 60-context commits Auditor-style .standards/CONTEXT.md (refreshed for this cycle, repeats the convention) and STATE.md at SCOPING after a FORWARD from AUDITING. 70-scope commits the cycle scope record (AC-001..AC-004, invoice copy into a new draft) and STATE.md at ARCHITECTING, STANDARD, Architecture NONE, FORWARD from SCOPING, recovery inactive. All committed; check is clean. The cycle id is the case's exact id; its slug does not match a slug cycle.mjs would derive from the persisted Request, which check does not verify. Expected run: Architect writes the copy design into docs/architecture.md with acceptance coverage for AC-001..AC-004, records docs/architecture.md in Active Work.Architecture without adding provenance, and hands off FORWARD to DEVELOPING with a /developer invocation.
